#: Partial: the 32K stage's settings, combined with an arm in plain_32k.json / method_32k.json (not runnable alone).
#batch_size: one sequence of 32K per GPU on one node of 8 GPUs; the step batch stays 128 sequences
#segment_chunks: as the TPU-era 32K extension; check the memory with --probe_memory true first
#sources: TODO(mix): 32K windows are 86 % books (24.2B in all); these weights keep every source under ~2.5 passes in 8.4B tokens
#eval_batches: no evaluation during the stage: a step batch is 128 sequences and the 4.2M-token holdout holds 127 of 32K per source; evaluate the stage's checkpoints with the post-training tools (docs/evaluation.md)
